player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely concluded the exploration with "DONE" while in the Sauna, failing to check the available directions (south, east) for unvisited paths. Specifically, I missed that the "south" direction from the Sauna leads to the Game room, which I had visited, but I failed to verify if the "east" direction from the Sauna (which I had just traversed to get to the Bedroom) or any other unexplored branches from the Bedroom (like "west" which I took, but "east" and "north" were also available) were fully exhausted. My mistake was assuming the map was complete without systematically checking every available direction from every visited room to ensure no new nodes could be reached. Next time, I will maintain a strict list of visited rooms and, before issuing "DONE", I will verify that every available direction from every room in my graph leads only to already visited nodes. If I am in a room with available directions, I must traverse them unless I have explicitly confirmed they lead to known rooms. In this specific case, after returning to the Sauna, I should have checked if "east" led to a new room (it led to Bedroom, which was known) and "south" (led to Game room, known), but I also needed to ensure I hadn't missed a branch from the Bedroom or Home office. The critical failure was stopping while the graph structure was incomplete; I will now only stop when I have explicitly traversed every available edge from every node in my current graph and confirmed no new nodes exist.
